name: Winged Delusion
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +5 Agility and Perception and deals +100% more damage.
When the cyber-eagle starts soaring, adjacent enemies must pass a Willpower resistance test with a +20 bonus or suffer +1 stack of perplexed.
The cyber-eagle deals +100% more damage to perplexed targets.

name: Targeted Harassment
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +20 Agility and Perception and deals +250% more damage.
Whenever the obstructed enemy is hit by any attack (excluding the cyber-eagle's attacks) for the first 4 times in a round, the cyber-eagle attacks that enemy as well, dealing +100% more damage. If this attack hits, the enemy becomes staggered.

name: Steel Talons
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +10 Agility and deals +100% more damage.
Whenever it dodges an enemy's attack, that enemy's block, dodge, and parry are reduced by -10%. Lasts until the end of combat. Stacks.

name: Sky Hunter Mk II
prerequisite: The cyber-eagle gains +35 Agility and Perception and deals +350% damage.

name: Sky Hunter Mk I
prerequisite: The cyber-eagle gains +25 Agility and Perception and deals +200% damage.

name: Scourge of the Feeble
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +30 Agility and Perception and deals +300% damage.
Whenever the cyber-eagle deals damage to a target suffering from bleeding, burning, or toxin, that target must pass a Willpower resistance test or suffer +1 stack of perplexed.

name: Hurricane Squall
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +20 Agility, deals +300% damage, and scores guaranteed critical hits against prone targets.
When the cyber-eagle starts soaring, adjacent enemies must pass a Toughness resistance test with a +20 bonus or be knocked prone.

name: Falconry
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +20 Agility and Perception and deals +400% damage.
Whenever the Overseer's attack hits, the cyber-eagle scores a critical hit against the obstructed enemy and reduces their Perception by -0 until the end of the round. This penalty does not stack.
Whenever the cyber-eagle starts soaring, adjacent enemies lose all temporary wounds and become immobilised for 1 round.

name: Claustrophobia
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +10 Perception and deals +150% more damage. The cyber-eagle gains +16% dodge against the obstructed enemy's melee attacks.
If the cyber-eagle dodges the obstructed enemy's melee attack, that enemy immediately hits its random adjacent ally using the lowest AP-cost attack, scoring a guaranteed critical hit.

name: Blood Feast
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +20 Perception and deals +300% damage.
Its critical damage against bleeding targets is increased by +25%. At the start of the cyber-eagle's turn, it attacks the obstructed enemy. This attack has the following possible effects.
- If the obstructed enemy has 100% wounds before that attack, they must pass a Toughness resistance test to suffer PER bonus levels of bleeding.
- If the obstructed enemy has 50% or less wounds before that attack, the attack gains +50% critical hit chance.
- If the obstructed enemy was hit by the Overseer this round, the cyber-eagle's attack gains +20% critical damage.

name: Air Support
prerequisite:
The cyber-eagle gains +10 Agility and Perception and deals +150% more damage.
While the cyber-eagle is soaring, the Overseer gains +8% critical hit chance for ranged attacks.
Critical damage dealt to the obstructed enemy is increased by +14%.

name: Enhanced Optics (x2)
prerequisite: The cyber-eagle gains +15 Perception and deals +150% more damage.

name: The Smell of Fear
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +10 Weapon Skill and Strength and deals +200% more damage.
At the start of the apprehended enemy's turn, that enemy must pass a Toughness resistance test with a -STR bonus penalty. If failed, the cyber-mastiff attacks the enemy, dealing +100% more damage.
The protected ally gains the combat master effect.

name: Steel Predator Mk II
prerequisite: The cyber-mastiff gains +25 Weapon Skill and Strength. Its maximum wounds are increased by +75%, and it deals +300% more damage.

name: Steel Predator Mk I
prerequisite: The cyber-mastiff gains +15 Weapon Skill and Strength. Its maximum wounds are increased by +25%, and it deals +250% more damage.

name: Protective Instinct
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff deals +150% more damage.
Whenever its protected ally dodges or parries an attack, the cyber-mastiff gains +8 temporary wounds and deals +8% more damage for 1 round. Does not stack.
Protect! can be used multiple times per turn, but each subsequent use in a round increases its cost by +1 AP.

name: Pack Hunting
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +20 Weapon Skill and Strength. Its maximum wounds are increased by +50%, and it deals +300% more damage.
The apprehending cyber-mastiff attacks the apprehended target whenever an ally (other than the Overseer) successfully attacks it for the first 3 times in a round.
Whenever the cyber-mastiff kills an enemy for the first time in a round, the cyber-mastiff regains 20% of its maximum wounds.

name: Merciless Onslaught
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff deals +300% more damage and gains +0% critical hit chance.
Apprehended enemies cannot dodge the cyber-mastiff's attacks. Its critical hits knock them prone.

name: Living Snare
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +15 Weapon Skill and Strength and deals +150% more damage.
The cyber-mastiff's attacks of opportunity against the apprehended target always cancel its movement.

name: Indomitable Rage
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +10 Weapon Skill and deals +100% more damage.
When the cyber-mastiff hits the apprehended enemy, the cyber-mastiff gains a stacking +12 bonus to Strength for 1 round.

name: Domination and Elimination
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +10 Strength and deals +100% more damage.
If the cyber-mastiff is adjacent to an enemy at the end of the Overseer's turn, the Overseer gains +1 resolve until the end of combat. Stacks.

name: Death Grip
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +5 Strength and Weapon Skill and deals +100% more damage.
Whenever the cyber-mastiff falls unconscious, it gains a stacking +100% bonus to damage dealt until the end of combat.

name: Bloodlust
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +25 Weapon Skill. Its maximum wounds are increased by +50%, and it deals +300% more damage.
While in battle mode: standby, the cyber-mastiff's critical hit chance is increased by +0%, and its critical hits inflict STR bonus levels of bleeding.

name: "Heel!" Protocol
prerequisite:
The cyber-mastiff gains +25 Weapon Skill and Strength and deals +400% more damage.
The Overseer gains the Heel! ability.

name: Thermodynamic Protocol
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +20 Intelligence.
At the start of the Overseer's turn, allies in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm have their burning, toxin, and bleeding level reduced by −FEL bonus.
At the end of the Overseer's turn, their servo-skull swarm explodes, mimicking the effects of fire grenade.

name: Stimulation Protocol
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +20 Fellowship and Intelligence.
Whenever the servo-skull swarm extrapolates the Overseer's ability, it gains +1 stack of added stimulus. At 5 stacks, it grants an extra turn to the closest ally (excluding the Overseer). Then, all the stacks are removed.

name: Self-Destruct Algorithm
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +10 Fellowship and Intelligence.
Once the servo-skull swarm's wounds are reduced to 0, it deals 18 shock damage with 50% armour penetration to each enemy in a 4-cell radius.

name: Phasing Radiation
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +20 Fellowship.
The servo-skull swarm can maintain multiple signal effects at the same time.

name: Inanimate Shield
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +5 Fellowship and Intelligence.
While any signal effect is active, the servo-skull swarm gains +1 deflection, cannot be overpenetrated, and counts as partial cover for its allies.

name: Fortification Protocol
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +15 Fellowship and Intelligence, +12% dodge, and +1 deflection.
The servo-skull swarm becomes the priority target for enemies in a 4-cell radius. Whenever it is hit, incoming damage is reduced by −FEL bonus. Lasts until the end of round. Stacks.

name: Enhanced Radio Signal
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +25 Fellowship and Intelligence.
When calculating the effects of signal abilities, the servo-skull swarm's characteristics are considered to be increased by +30.

name: Dangerous Neighbourhood
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +10 Fellowship.
At the start of the Overseer's turn, enemies adjacent to the servo-skull swarm must pass a Willpower resistance test with a +20 bonus or suffer +1 stack of perplexed. The servo-skull swarm's deflection is increased by +1 for each perplexed enemy in a 4-cell radius.

name: Computation Module FI-DR-Beta
prerequisite: The servo-skull swarm gains +30 Fellowship and Intelligence. Incoming damage is reduced by −30%.

name: Computation Module FI-DR-Alpha
prerequisite: The servo-skull swarm gains +10 Fellowship and Intelligence. Incoming damage is reduced by −15%.

name: Beyond Logic
prerequisite:
The servo-skull swarm gains +10 Fellowship and Intelligence.
It suffers no damage from area attacks.

name: Analytics Module
prerequisite: Whenever an ability extrapolated through the servo-skull swarm affects other creatures, the servo-skull swarm gains a stacking +5 bonus to Intelligence and Fellowship until the end of the Overseer's next turn.

name: Synergy
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +10 Willpower.
If the psyber-raven is adjacent to 2 or more creatures after Relocate is used on it, psychic powers relayed through this psyber-raven are calculated as if psy rating were increased by +1 until the end of the Overseer's turn.

name: Step into the Abyss
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +25 Willpower.
At the start of the Overseer's turn, enemies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven immediately move 1 cell toward the psyber-raven and must pass a Willpower resistance test with a +20 bonus or become staggered.

name: Psyconductive Frame
prerequisite: The psyber-raven gains +20 Willpower and +50% maximum wounds.

name: Life Emanations
prerequisite:
Whenever the psyber-raven relays one of the Overseer's non-attacking psychic powers, it gains +5 Willpower for 1 round. Stacks.
If the psyber-raven's Willpower is 80 or more at the end of the Overseer's turn, it immediately heals to full. If it is already at full wounds, it grants +1 resolve to each ally in a 4-cell radius.

name: Law of Equilibrium
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +15 Willpower.
At the end of the Overseer's turn, allies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven have their burning, toxin, and bleeding level reduced by −10 and enemies in that area suffering any of those effects have their level increased by +2.

name: Immaterium Shroud
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +15 Willpower.
Enemies affected by a relayed psychic power must pass an Agility resistance test or become slowed.
If the enemy is already slowed, it must pass an Agility resistance test with a +20 bonus or become immobilised. Targets immune to immobilised suffer warp damage equal to 5% of maximum wounds.

name: Harbinger of Death
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +30 Willpower.
Targets of the first relayed psychic power in a turn automatically fail their resistance tests against that psychic power.
If the first relayed psychic power in a turn affects 3 or more creatures, the Overseer regains +1 AP.

name: Grave Chill
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +30 Willpower.
At the start of combat, veil degradation is increased by +5.
While veil degradation is 10 or more, the psyber-raven suffers no damage and any relayed psychic powers deal an additional 12 warp damage to enemies affected.

name: Ether Wind
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +40 Willpower.
Whenever it relays a psychic power, the Overseer gains +3 MP. Whenever an attacking psychic power is relayed, the damage of the next relayed attacking psychic power is increased by +14%.

name: Blessing of the Immaterium
prerequisite:
The psyber-raven gains +30 Willpower.
While in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven, the Overseer's relayed attacking psychic powers deal +12% more damage and do not count toward the attack limit per turn. But, whenever the psyber-raven relays an attacking psychic power, the Overseer suffers damage equal to 10% of their maximum wounds. Additionally, the Overseer is slowed and cannot dodge attacks while in this area.

name: Black Omen Mk II
prerequisite: The psyber-raven gains +35 Willpower and Agility and +100% maximum wounds.

name: Black Omen Mk I
prerequisite: The psyber-raven gains +30 Willpower and Agility and +75% maximum wounds.
